name: Heavy repeating blaster
description: A heavy repeating blaster, also known as a heavy repeater blaster, was a type of powerful repeating blaster. E-Web heavy repeating blaster cannons, "Roba" M-45 repeating ion blasters, MWC-35c "Staccato Lightning" repeating cannons, and TL-50 Heavy Repeaters were heavy repeating blasters that saw use in the galaxy.
